name: typst
description_en: A markup-based typesetting system that is powerful and easy to learn.
readme_excerpt: Typst is a new markup-based typesetting system that is designed to be as powerful as LaTeX while being much easier to learn and use. Typst has: - Built-in markup for the most common formatting tasks - Flexible functions for everything else - A tightly integrated scripting system - Math typesetting, bibliography management, and more - Fast compile times thanks to incremental compilation - Friendly error messages in case something goes wrong This repository contains the Typst compiler and its CLI…
